note_text:
CHIEF COMPLAINT: Persistent cough for 10 days.

REVIEW OF SYSTEMS: Positive for cough and fatigue. Negative for fever, chest pain, hemoptysis.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY: Seasonal allergies.

VITALS: BP 116/70, HR 78, Temp 98.6F, RR 16, SpO2 98% on room air.

PHYSICAL EXAM: Lungs clear to auscultation bilaterally. No wheezing or crackles. Oropharynx normal.

ASSESSMENT: Post-viral cough.

PLAN: Supportive care, honey/lozenges, return if cough persists beyond 3 weeks or fever develops.
